reason.fx-committed: The exchange-rate commitment currently prevents an independent rate change.
reason.command-economy: The economy currently uses command allocation instead of an independent policy rate.
reason.term-cap: The rate-change budget for this term is exhausted.
reason.cooldown: Another rate change occurred too recently.
reason.delta-hike: The proposed hike exceeds the current adjustment limit.
reason.delta-cut: The proposed cut exceeds the current adjustment limit.
reason.out-of-range: The proposed rate is outside the permitted range.
reason.unknown: Current monetary policy prevents this rate change.

money.transition: The accounting method changed. Growth resumes after 12 turns measured with the same method; older observations remain historical and are not comparable.
money.legacy: Legacy accounting observation. This stock uses the previous method and is excluded from current money-growth decisions.
money.stockExplanation: M1 counts spendable account balances. M2 adds savings, NPC bank deposits, external deposits and market pool cash. Demographic household estimates are shown separately and do not enter either total.
